method: One cold `claude -p` CLI session (claude-sonnet-5) captured all 15 screenshots via global playwright, then was resumed once per image with an identical analysis prompt (Read the PNG, layout-only findings as strict JSON). Per-image token numbers are the CLI's own reported usage for that resumed turn. The session accumulates: each turn's cache_read includes all previously analyzed images, so cache_read growth across the run is the cost of one-session-many-images.
notes: Every PNG's height equals the viewport height despite fullPage:true — these catalog pages are fill-shaped; scrolling happens in an inner region, so the document never scrolls and 'full height' == viewport height.
Analysis order: fit, flex, grid, document, docs; 400 then 1920 then 3440 within each page.
